natural: use capital to make a profit

meaning.en: To invest capital in order to earn a profit; to do business with one's own money.
meaning.zh: 拿本钱去做生意，以求获得利润。

equivalents: invest capital to make a profit

examples.zh: 他将本求利，在镇上开了一家小店。
examples.en: He put up his savings to make a profit and opened a small shop in town.

examples.zh: 做生意总是将本求利，不能只想着不花钱。
examples.en: Business always means investing capital for a return; you can't expect to spend nothing.

examples.zh: 两兄弟合伙将本求利，几年后生意红火起来。
examples.en: The two brothers pooled their capital, and after a few years the business thrived.

usage.en: Predicate, often in older-style narration of trade.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于叙述经商的文字。

meaning.en: A very, very long time; for all time.
meaning.zh: 形容时间极其长久。

examples.zh: 这座古塔屹立在山顶，仿佛千年万载都不会变。
examples.en: The old pagoda stands on the hilltop as if it would never change for ages.

examples.zh: 他们发誓，爱情要千年万载地延续下去。
examples.en: They vowed their love would last for all eternity.

examples.zh: 千年万载的黄河，日夜奔流不息。
examples.en: The Yellow River, flowing for ages upon ages, never stops day or night.

usage.en: Adverbial or attributive; literary, emphatic.
usage.zh: 多作状语、定语，带夸张色彩，书面语。

meaning.en: Tears and snot streaming down together; weeping bitterly.
meaning.zh: 眼泪鼻涕一起流下来，形容极度悲伤或激动。

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她涕泪交流，说不出话来。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news she wept bitterly and could not speak.

examples.zh: 老人读着儿子的家书，涕泪交流。
examples.en: The old man read his son's letter home with tears streaming down his face.

examples.zh: 战友重逢，个个涕泪交流。
examples.en: The comrades were reunited, all of them in tears.

usage.en: Predicate; strong emotion, slightly literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，感情强烈，略带书面色彩。

meaning.en: To be remembered forever and never fade away; of lasting fame or value.
meaning.zh: 永远不会磨灭，形容功绩、作品等流传久远。

examples.zh: 这部史诗是千古不朽的杰作。
examples.en: This epic is an immortal masterpiece.

examples.zh: 英雄的事迹将千古不朽。
examples.en: The hero's deeds will never be forgotten.

examples.zh: 他们用生命换来了千古不朽的功绩。
examples.en: They gave their lives for achievements that will last through the ages.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; used for deeds and works, solemn tone.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，用于功绩、作品，语气庄重。

meaning.en: Brimming with spirit and energy; of a performance or piece of art, fully realised and vivid.
meaning.zh: 精神饱满，气势充足；也形容艺术作品神韵完备。

examples.zh: 老教授讲起课来神完气足，丝毫不显疲态。
examples.en: The old professor lectures with full vigour and shows no sign of tiredness.

examples.zh: 这幅骏马图画得神完气足，仿佛要奔出纸外。
examples.en: This painting of a horse is so full of life that it seems about to gallop off the page.

examples.zh: 演员一上台，便神完气足，全场目光都被吸引过去。
examples.en: The moment the actor stepped on stage, brimming with presence, every eye was drawn to him.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; for people, performances and artworks.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，可形容人、表演或艺术作品。

meaning.en: Stars and moon shining together in the night sky.
meaning.zh: 星星和月亮相互辉映，形容夜景明朗美丽。

examples.zh: 夜空中星月交辉，湖面一片银光。
examples.en: Stars and moon shone together overhead, and the lake gleamed silver.

examples.zh: 山顶星月交辉，我们坐在帐篷外聊到深夜。
examples.en: Stars and moon glittered over the summit as we chatted outside the tent late into the night.

examples.zh: 这首诗写出了塞外星月交辉的辽阔夜色。
examples.en: The poem captures the vast starlit night beyond the frontier.

usage.en: Predicate; descriptive, literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，描写夜景，书面语。

natural: just to add one more type

meaning.en: To include something merely to make up the numbers or add one more variety; it is not outstanding.
meaning.zh: 姑且算作一种风格或类别，多用作谦辞，也含不太出色之意。

equivalents: just for the sake of variety

examples.zh: 这几首小诗不成熟，聊备一格而已。
examples.en: These little poems are immature, offered merely to add some variety.

examples.zh: 展览中加了几件民间玩具，聊备一格。
examples.en: A few folk toys were added to the exhibition just to round it out.

examples.zh: 我的方案不算高明，聊备一格，供大家参考。
examples.en: My proposal is nothing special; take it as one more option for your reference.

usage.en: Predicate; humble self-deprecation about one's own work, or a mild criticism.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于谦称自己的作品，也可含贬义。

meaning.en: The major, most conspicuous points of a matter.
meaning.zh: 指主要的、明显的方面或事项。

examples.zh: 会议只谈了几件荦荦大端，细节留待以后再议。
examples.en: The meeting only covered the main matters, leaving the details for later.

examples.zh: 这本书叙述了明代政治的荦荦大端。
examples.en: The book narrates the major features of Ming politics.

examples.zh: 先把荦荦大端定下来，其余的好办。
examples.en: Settle the big points first, and the rest will be easy.

usage.en: Usually an object, as in 举其荦荦大端; formal and bookish. 荦 is read luò.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，如“举其荦荦大端”，书面语。“荦”读 luò。

natural: give all one's loyalty and wit

meaning.en: To devote all one's loyalty and intelligence to a cause or a ruler.
meaning.zh: 用尽自己的忠诚和智慧。

equivalents: give one's all in loyal service
devote all one's loyalty and wisdom

examples.zh: 大臣竭忠尽智，辅佐幼主治理国家。
examples.en: The minister gave all his loyalty and wit to help the young ruler govern.

examples.zh: 他竭忠尽智为公司谋划，却被人误解。
examples.en: He devoted all his loyalty and ingenuity to the company's plans, yet was misunderstood.

examples.zh: 医生们竭忠尽智，终于救回了病人。
examples.en: The doctors gave their all and finally saved the patient.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, often about service to a state or employer.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，多指为国家或主上效力。

meaning.en: The phoenix comes and dances; a sign of an auspicious age and of great fortune.
meaning.zh: 凤凰飞来，翩翩起舞，是吉祥太平的征兆。

equivalents: the phoenix descends in auspicious omen
a good omen of a golden age

examples.zh: 新馆落成之日，人们赞为凤凰来仪的吉兆。
examples.en: On the day the new hall opened, people hailed it as an auspicious omen.

examples.zh: 婚礼上，司仪祝愿新人凤凰来仪，琴瑟和鸣。
examples.en: At the wedding the host wished the couple good fortune and harmony.

examples.zh: 古人认为圣君在位，便会有凤凰来仪。
examples.en: The ancients believed that phoenixes would appear when a sage ruled.

story.en: In the Book of Documents, when the music of Shun's 《箫韶》 was played nine times, the male and female phoenix came and danced.
story.zh: 《尚书·益稷》：“箫韶九成，凤皇来仪。”

usage.en: Predicate; auspicious, literary, used in blessings. 仪 means a dignified bearing here.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于祝颂，书面语。“仪”指有威仪的样子。

meaning.en: Looking or acting silly and slow-witted.
meaning.zh: 形容人呆头呆脑、痴傻的样子。

examples.zh: 他傻头傻脑地站在门口，不知道该进还是该走。
examples.en: He stood dopily at the door, not knowing whether to come in or leave.

examples.zh: 别看他傻头傻脑的，其实心里明白得很。
examples.en: Though he looks goofy, he knows exactly what's going on.

examples.zh: 那只傻头傻脑的小狗一路追着我们跑。
examples.en: That goofy little dog ran after us all the way.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; casual, sometimes affectionate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，口语，有时带亲昵意味。

natural: the mountains ring and the valleys answer

meaning.en: A loud sound making the mountains resound and the valleys echo; also, a powerful momentum that draws wide response.
meaning.zh: 山谷里回声响应，形容声音巨大；也比喻声势浩大。

equivalents: the mountains ring and the valleys echo

examples.zh: 一声炮响，山鸣谷应。
examples.en: A cannon shot rang out and the hills echoed it.

examples.zh: 号子声震天，工地上山鸣谷应。
examples.en: The work chants thundered and the whole site resounded.

examples.zh: 他在峰顶大喊一声，立刻山鸣谷应。
examples.en: He shouted at the summit and at once the mountains echoed back.

usage.en: Predicate; descriptive and literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，描写声响，书面语。

meaning.en: One person holding two posts or carrying out two duties at once.
meaning.zh: 一个人同时担任两个职务或承担两项工作。

examples.zh: 王老师一身二任，既教语文又管后勤。
examples.en: Mr Wang wears two hats, teaching Chinese and managing logistics.

examples.zh: 小店人手少，大家都得一身二任。
examples.en: The shop is short-staffed, so everyone has to do double duty.

examples.zh: 这个设备一身二任，既能打印又能扫描。
examples.en: This machine does double duty, printing and scanning.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral, often about posts or functions.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，指职务或功能，中性。

meaning.en: Peach blossoms and running water; a picture of tranquil spring scenery or an idyllic retreat; also of fleeting spring.
meaning.zh: 桃花盛开、流水潺潺，形容幽静的春日景色或世外桃源；也比喻春光易逝。

examples.zh: 山中桃花流水，宛如仙境。
examples.en: With peach blossoms and flowing streams, the mountains look like fairyland.

examples.zh: 春深时节，桃花流水，处处是诗意。
examples.en: In deep spring, with peach blossoms and running streams, poetry is everywhere.

examples.zh: 他向往桃花流水般的隐居生活。
examples.en: He longs for a secluded life amid peach blossoms and flowing streams.

story.en: Li Bai's poem on living in the green mountains ends: peach blossoms drift away on the water into a world beyond the human one.
story.zh: 李白《山中问答》：“桃花流水窅然去，别有天地非人间。”

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; poetic scenery; also associated with the hermit's retreat.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，描写景色，常联想到隐居之境。

meaning.en: The elegant, carefree life of a literatus who enjoys poetry and wine.
meaning.zh: 形容文人吟诗饮酒、潇洒不拘的生活。

equivalents: a life of poetry and wine

examples.zh: 他年轻时诗酒风流，结交了不少文人朋友。
examples.en: In youth he lived a life of poetry and wine and befriended many literati.

examples.zh: 这家茶馆自称承继了诗酒风流的传统。
examples.en: This teahouse claims to carry on the tradition of poetry and wine.

examples.zh: 李白的一生，可谓诗酒风流。
examples.en: Li Bai's life can be called one of poetry, wine and free spirit.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; admiring but may hint at indulgence.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多含赞赏，有时也暗含放纵。

natural: aid the world and secure the state

meaning.en: To help the world and bring peace to the nation.
meaning.zh: 救助世人，使国家安定。

equivalents: save the world and secure the nation
serve the nation and its people

examples.zh: 他从小立志济世安邦，后来考入政法大学。
examples.en: He resolved from youth to serve the nation, and later entered a university of political science and law.

examples.zh: 古代读书人多怀济世安邦之志。
examples.en: Scholars of old often cherished the ambition of aiding the world and securing the state.

examples.zh: 这位宰相以济世安邦为己任。
examples.en: This chancellor took it as his duty to aid the world and secure the realm.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (济世安邦之才). Also written 济世安民.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语（济世安邦之才）。也作“济世安民”。

meaning.en: To stand apart from the crowd, free of worldly entanglements.
meaning.zh: 超脱于世俗之外，不依附他人，独自站立。

examples.zh: 面对派系之争，他超然独立，不偏不倚。
examples.en: Faced with factional struggles, he stood aloof and impartial.

examples.zh: 这位学者一生超然独立，不求名利。
examples.en: The scholar lived aloof and independent, seeking neither fame nor gain.

examples.zh: 评论员应当超然独立，才能公正。
examples.en: A commentator should stay independent to be fair.

usage.en: Predicate; often praising detachment from factions or fame.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常赞许不依附派系、不追名利。

meaning.en: A bamboo fence and a thatched cottage; a simple, rustic dwelling.
meaning.zh: 竹子编的篱笆，茅草盖的房屋，形容简朴的乡村住处。

examples.zh: 山脚下几处竹篱茅舍，炊烟袅袅。
examples.en: A few bamboo-fenced thatched cottages stood at the foot of the hill, smoke curling up.

examples.zh: 他厌倦了城市，只想住在竹篱茅舍里。
examples.en: Tired of the city, he only wanted to live in a thatched cottage.

examples.zh: 画中竹篱茅舍，一派田园风光。
examples.en: In the painting, bamboo fences and thatched huts make a pastoral scene.

usage.en: Noun phrase; describing rustic scenes.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，描写田园景象。

meaning.en: Worn out by endless paperwork and official business.
meaning.zh: 被繁重的公文事务弄得身心疲惫。

examples.zh: 他整日案牍劳形，难得有时间陪家人。
examples.en: Worn out by paperwork all day, he seldom has time for his family.

examples.zh: 机关里的小职员，多半案牍劳形。
examples.en: Most junior clerks in the office are exhausted by paperwork.

examples.zh: 退休后，他终于摆脱了案牍劳形的生活。
examples.en: After retirement he finally escaped a life of paperwork drudgery.

story.en: Liu Yuxi's 'Inscription for a Humble Room' says that there is no noisy music to disturb the ear and no official documents to tire the body.
story.zh: 刘禹锡《陋室铭》：“无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。”

usage.en: Predicate; contrasts with a quiet, leisurely life.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与清闲生活相对。

natural: never tired of going into detail

meaning.en: To be willing to explain in full detail without weariness.
meaning.zh: 不嫌详细，指耐心地详细说明。

examples.zh: 老师不厌其详地讲解每一个步骤。
examples.en: The teacher patiently explained every step in detail.

examples.zh: 他不厌其详，把事情的来龙去脉说了一遍。
examples.en: He went through the whole story in full detail.

examples.zh: 客服不厌其详地回答了我的问题。
examples.en: The customer service agent answered my questions in painstaking detail.

usage.en: Adverbial, usually 不厌其详地 + verb. Compare 不厌其烦.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“不厌其详地……”。可对比“不厌其烦”。

meaning.en: A highly skilled painter.
meaning.zh: 指技艺高超的画家。

equivalents: a gifted hand with the brush

examples.zh: 他是当代的丹青妙手，作品屡获大奖。
examples.en: He is a master painter of our day whose works have won many prizes.

examples.zh: 这幅山水出自丹青妙手，笔力不凡。
examples.en: This landscape comes from a master painter's hand, with remarkable brushwork.

examples.zh: 展览汇集了多位丹青妙手的佳作。
examples.en: The exhibition brings together fine works by several master painters.

usage.en: Noun; praising a painter. 丹青 stands for painting.
usage.zh: 作名词，称赞画家。“丹青”代指绘画。

meaning.en: To last forever.
meaning.zh: 永远存在，永不消逝。

examples.zh: 山河万古长存，而人生不过百年。
examples.en: Mountains and rivers endure forever, while a human life is but a hundred years.

examples.zh: 愿我们的友谊万古长存。
examples.en: May our friendship last forever.

examples.zh: 英雄的精神万古长存。
examples.en: The hero's spirit will live on for all time.

usage.en: Predicate; often used in wishes and tributes.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于祝愿和颂词。

meaning.en: Bursting with strength and vigour.
meaning.zh: 形容精力旺盛，身体强壮，气势足。

examples.zh: 别看他年纪大了，干起活来还气壮如牛。
examples.en: Old as he is, he still works as strong as an ox.

examples.zh: 喝了热汤，人一下子气壮如牛。
examples.en: After the hot soup, he felt strong as an ox.

examples.zh: 这孩子气壮如牛，一顿能吃三碗饭。
examples.en: The boy is strong as an ox and can eat three bowls of rice at a sitting.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; colloquial and vivid.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，口语，形象生动。

meaning.en: To sacrifice one's own interests for the benefit of others.
meaning.zh: 牺牲自己的利益，使别人得到好处。

examples.zh: 他损己利人的精神，赢得了大家的尊敬。
examples.en: His spirit of self-sacrifice won everyone's respect.

examples.zh: 损己利人的事，他从不犹豫。
examples.en: He never hesitates over things that cost him but help others.

examples.zh: 商人讲究和气生财，但不会真的损己利人。
examples.en: Merchants value harmony for profit but won't truly sacrifice themselves for others.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; contrast with 损人利己.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语；与“损人利己”相对。
